paragraphs: Welcome to Green Hill Park! Here is a guide for your visit. The park is open from eight in the morning to six in the evening.
At the top of the hill, there is a tall building with a great view. You can walk up the hill or ride a bicycle. It takes about twenty minutes to reach the top.
The park is famous for its ducks. Last year, many visitors came here to feed them. Some people brought umbrellas because it was often foggy in the morning.
Please stay on the path and keep the park clean. A happy journey begins with a good plan. Enjoy your visit!

How can you reach the top of the hill?
Why did some visitors bring umbrellas last year?
opts: Because it was often foggy in the morning.

questions.q: What is the park famous for?
What is the passage mainly about?
opts: A guide for visiting a park.

paragraphs: Last summer, my family took a journey to the mountains. It was an unforgettable trip.
We left home early in the morning. The weather was foggy, so my mother took an umbrella. We climbed a small hill and walked a long distance. Everyone was a little tired but happy.
On the way, we saw a trader selling food. We were hungry, so we bought some bread and fruit. Near a small lake, we saw some ducks. I imagined how much fun it was to feed them.
At the end of the day, we realized how enjoyable the journey was. We took many pictures and wrote our memories in a diary. Nothing was boring about that trip.

questions.q: Where did the family go last summer?
Why did the mother take an umbrella?
What did the family buy from the trader?
What does the underlined word "journey" mean?
How did the family feel about the trip?

reading_c.provenance: 真题母本改编 + 原创（教师授权 2026-08-08）
reading_c.绑定: G52 过去时 / G54 频度副词跨时态 / 旅行词汇
paragraphs: Travel is important for teenagers. It helps them learn about the world and grow up.
When you travel, you see new places and meet new people. You realize that the world is big and full of different cultures. Each journey teaches you something new.

Last year, a group of students went abroad for a study trip. They visited many famous buildings and talked with traders. They were excited about the entire journey. Before the trip, they had never been so far from home.
Now they often share their memories with others. Travel makes their lives richer. It is a good idea to travel and learn at the same time.

questions.q: Why is travel important for teenagers?
opts: It helps them learn about the world.

questions.q: What did the students do last year?
opts: They went abroad for a study trip.

questions.q: How had the students felt before the trip?
opts: They had never been so far from home.

questions.q: What do the students often do now?
What is the passage mainly about?
opts: Why travel is good for teenagers.

sa.title: 阅读表达
paragraphs: An Unforgettable Journey
Last summer, my family went to the mountains for a journey. It was an unforgettable trip.
We left home early in the morning. The weather was sunny and warm. We climbed a small hill and walked a long distance. Everyone was tired but happy.
At noon, we were hungry, so we bought some bread and fruit from a trader. Near a lake, we saw some ducks swimming. I wanted to feed them, but I did not have any bread left.
When we got home, I wrote everything in my diary. I realized how enjoyable the journey was. Nothing was boring about that day.

questions.q: When did the family go to the mountains?
What did the family buy from the trader?
What did the writer see near the lake?
请把文中画线句子翻译成汉语（Nothing was boring about that day.）
questions.answer: 那一天没有什么是无聊的。

writing.title: 书面表达
writing.prompt:
假如你是李华，请你用英语写一篇90词左右的短文，介绍你一次难忘的旅行经历。内容包括：
1. 你去了哪里、和谁一起去（用过去时）；
2. 你看到了什么、做了什么（用 journey/mountain/lake/duck 等旅行词汇）；
3. 你的感受是什么（用 enjoyable/unforgettable 等）。
sample: Last month, I went on a journey to the countryside with my family. It was an unforgettable trip.
We left home early in the morning. The weather was sunny and warm. We climbed a small hill and saw many beautiful flowers. Near a lake, we saw some ducks swimming in the water.
We were hungry, so we bought some bread and fruit from a trader. Everyone was tired but happy. When we got home, I wrote my memories in a diary.
I realized how enjoyable the journey was. I hope we can go there again next year.
writing.requirements: 1. 词数约 90 词；2. 用过去时描写旅行经历；3. 语句通顺，意思连贯，语法正确；4. 可适当发挥。
